mapper.select: select id, municipality_id as municipalityId, holiday_date, name_fr, name_en, name_zh, shift_days, sector, source_url, active from collection_holiday where municipality_id = #{municipalityId} order by holiday_date asc
mapper.insert: insert into collection_holiday (municipality_id, holiday_date, name_fr, name_en, name_zh, shift_days, sector, source_url, active) values (#{municipalityId}, #{holidayDate}, #{nameFr}, #{nameEn}, #{nameZh}, #{shiftDays}, #{sector}, #{sourceUrl}, #{active})
mapper.update: update collection_holiday set holiday_date = #{holidayDate}, name_fr = #{nameFr}, name_en = #{nameEn}, name_zh = #{nameZh}, shift_days = #{shiftDays}, sector = #{sector}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, active = #{active} where id = #{id}
